##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 15 October 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Polar maritime airmass covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 later tonight, veering west or northwest tomorrow morning, then north or northwest in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain in the southeast of the area at first, then isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, soon veering north or northeast 3 or 4, then east or northeast later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in places at first.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, soon becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
